# Wide View

Wide View widens the reading and editing views and, by its own recorded description, touches nothing else. That description states that Obsidian otherwise locks notes to a narrow, fixed reading width, which on a wide monitor leaves large empty margins and short, cramped lines that suit prose but not tables, code blocks or dense documents.

![Wide View screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jkraccoon/obsidian-wide-view/HEAD/screen.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Wide View"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/jkraccoon/obsidian-wide-view"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jkraccoon/obsidian-wide-view/HEAD/screen.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Your Obsidian, exactly as it is — just wider. 읽기 뷰와 편집 뷰의 가로 폭을 넓게 확장시켜줌. 그 외에는 아무것도 건드리지 않는다. 넓게보고싶다면 간편하게 쓰세요. Out of the box, Obsidian locks your notes to a narrow, fixed reading width. On a wide monitor that leaves huge empty margins and cramped, short lines — fine for prose, frustrating for tables, code blocks, and dense documents."
```
